Italiani's Pizza on Nguyen Thai Binh street is located in the bustling heart of District 1, just steps from Ben Thanh Market — one of the most iconic landmarks in Ho Chi Minh City.

Whether you're craving a classic Margherita or something more adventurous, Italiani's delivers quality Italian food in a vibrant setting.

District 1 is the commercial and tourist heart of Ho Chi Minh City, making this one of the most accessible BTM locations for both visitors and residents. The area is well-served by public transport and is within walking distance of numerous hotels, shops, and attractions.

Stop by Italiani's for a slice of Italy in Vietnam, and while you're at it, use the BTM to stack some sats.
